patch_description:
Replace the current parameter-heavy, per-qubit RY/RZ-only chain with a more structured “2-parameter per layer” ansatz that:
1) Uses even/odd qubit parameter sharing to dramatically cut N_PARAMS (better parameter efficiency, less overfitting),
2) Adds a full 3-matchings cube-like CZ entangling pattern (better correlation mixing than a simple chain),
3) Keeps trainable post-rotation (final shared RY/RZ) so the fixed Z readout can access the encoded information.

This is consistent with the fixed training loop and re-upload/block structure, changing only ANSATZ_SPEC.
